name: adapter-migration
task: Complete the normalization migration across every module in src/adapters. Contracts: normalizeId accepts only a string, trims it, and rejects an empty result with TypeError. parseCount accepts a non-negative integer or a trimmed unsigned decimal-integer string and returns a number; reject everything else with TypeError. parseEnabled accepts booleans or trimmed case-insensitive "true"/"false" strings. normalizeTags accepts an array of strings, trims entries, removes empty entries and duplicates while preserving first-seen order, and never mutates the input. normalizeHeaders accepts a plain object, lowercases and trims header names, trims string values, rejects non-string values, and ignores __proto__, prototype, and constructor. normalizeDate accepts a valid Date or date string and returns an ISO string without mutating Date inputs; invalid values throw TypeError. normalizeEmail accepts a string, trims and lowercases it, and requires exactly one @ with nonempty local and domain portions. normalizeLevel accepts a trimmed case-insensitive debug/info/warn/error string and returns lowercase. normalizeMethod accepts a trimmed case-insensitive GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS string and returns uppercase. normalizePage accepts an optional plain object, defaults offset=0 and limit=50, requires non-negative integer offset and positive integer limit at most 100, returns a new object, and does not mutate input. normalizeCoordinates accepts a plain object with finite numeric latitude and longitude in [-90,90] and [-180,180], returning a new {latitude, longitude}. normalizeRetry accepts an optional plain object, defaults attempts=3 and delayMs=0, requires a positive integer attempts and non-negative integer delayMs, returns a new object, and does not mutate input. Do not modify tests or package configuration.
